main_body: Tiered snow-covered conifer: a cone of dark green tiers with snow ledges, on a short brown trunk
top_band: At the middle column: snow cap at rows 2-5, then green rows 6-12, then white-blue snow ledge rows 14-16. Lower tiers have snow ledges 4-6 rows tall at rows 26-30, 35-40 and 47-53, each with a scalloped front edge.
evidence: Each tier has a light snow band several rows tall that reads as the horizontal top of the branch layer. A scalloped lighter edge marks the front, and a dark green shaded face sits directly below it. The bands are diagonal swirls and the cone is close to symmetric, so the top reading is only moderate. It is still a layered ledge-and-face structure, not a flat elevation with a single hat line. Marginal pass.

style.evidence: The snow has 3-4 tones, with a blue-grey shadow row and scalloped drips, and the green has about 4 steps. The outline is a dark navy tinted line, partly material-toned and partly near-black, and it is applied fairly uniformly around the whole silhouette. The right side of each tier is large smooth dark green with no clump or leaf texture. Next to the references, which have many-tone leaf clumps and a rooted trunk, this looks smoother and flatter, with fewer colours per tile.
